# With the Patient at the Heart

We develop software that helps people get well, helps people stay well, and helps future generations
be healthier.
[Our story →][1]

## Nurses Save Time and Keep Families Connected Using AI

At UNC Health, Riverside Health, and WakeMed, nurses reduce documentation time and improve patient &
family communication with the help of Art, Epic’s AI for clinicians.
[Learn more →][2]

## Teamwork Staff Scheduling Delivers Faster Care Coordination and Reduces Administrative Work at
## Health Systems Worldwide

Organizations report on the benefits of Teamwork—the first application in EpicOps, Epic’s integrated
Enterprise Resource Planning suite built for healthcare.
[Learn more →][3]

## UnityPoint Health Saves Lives with Better Sepsis Detection and Treatment in Pregnancy

Detection criteria and care path built into Epic EHR help clinicians identify sepsis in maternal
patients sooner and reduce time to treatment.
[Learn more →][4]

Alongside healthcare providers, Epic is taking legal action to defend patient privacy.
[Read more →][5]

# Our Software

Our software makes it possible for every patient to have a single, comprehensive medical record that
informs and is informed by their health experiences. The goal is higher-quality, more personalized
care that's simpler for patients, medical professionals, and everyone who makes healthcare happen.
[Learn more about our software →][6]

### From Phone Tag to Push Notifications: How Four Health Systems Closed the Loop on Critical Lab
### Communication

July 06, 2026
Four health systems are among those that have replaced phone calls for critical lab result
communication with Epic push notifications, achieving acknowledgement times under one
minute—compared to an average of seven to twelve minutes previously. Lab staff save approximately
ten minutes per result, which adds up to enough time saved at one organization for 15 full-time
staff members to focus on higher-value work. Clinicians acted faster on critical results, where
every minute matters.
[Read the full story on EpicShare →][8]
[Providing Pain Relief for Sickle Cell Crises Faster with Personal, Portable Care Plans]

### Providing Pain Relief for Sickle Cell Crises Faster with Personal, Portable Care Plans

June 22, 2026
Manchester University NHS Foundation Trust developed a digital sickle cell care program to improve
tracking and transparency of emergency pain management. The program includes personalized emergency
care plans and an ED order set. Patients went from having no digital care plans to 89% coverage, and
active patient portal usage among people with sickle cell disease increased from 43% to 58%.
[Read the full story on EpicShare →][9]
[Using Telecritical Care to Reduce ICU Mortality]

### Using Telecritical Care to Reduce ICU Mortality

June 15, 2026
To provide expert overnight critical care, Kaiser Permanente Northern California implemented a
telecritical care program that connects remote intensivists and nurses to ICUs through real-time
monitoring, camera feeds, and instant communication. Today, the program is in use across 18 ICUs and
is associated with a 7% reduction in adjusted mortality.
[Read the full story on EpicShare →][10]
[AI Coding Assistant Reduces Chart Review Time by 20%, Freeing Coders for Higher-Value Work]

### AI Coding Assistant Reduces Chart Review Time by 20%, Freeing Coders for Higher-Value Work

June 08, 2026
After implementing Epic’s AI Professional Billing Coding Assistant, coders at Baptist Health in
Jacksonville, Florida spend 20% less time reviewing charts—an estimated $924,000 in annual labor
savings. Clean claim rates and coder productivity have also improved.
[Read the full story on EpicShare →][11]

the belief that we can fulfill our responsibilities as a corporate citizen by giving back to the
communities we serve. Ever since then, we have pursued the ideal of "doing well by doing good." This
spirit of individuals helping society is exemplified through Henry Schein Cares, our global
corporate social responsibility program.

  Take a look at our list of businesses.
  
  [ Our Businesses ][52]
  * [Pharmaceutical, Medical Supplies & Products Distribution Services][53]
    
    We distribute pharmaceuticals and medical supplies to healthcare settings across North America,
    from pharmacies and hospitals to doctors’ offices and clinics.
    * [Pharmaceutical Distribution Services][54]
    * [Medical Supply Distribution][55]
  * [Pharmacy Services][56]
    
    We help to ensure the financial wellbeing of pharmacies and health systems and support a stable
    work environment for their employees.
  * [Oncology & Multispecialty Solutions][57]
    
    We provide research, insights, technologies and other support to help address challenges in
    cancer and specialty care.
  * [Biopharma Capabilities][58]
    
    We provide a suite of solutions designed to address access, affordability and adherence
    challenges by bridging the gaps between biopharma companies, pharmacies, providers, and payers
    to help patients get on and stay on their medications.
  * [Prescription Benefit Solutions][59]
    
    We offer solutions that enable employers, payers, health-plan brokers and government agencies to
    provide lower-cost options for prescription medications and therapies.
  * [Consumer Products & Services][60]
    
    We help to ensure the financial wellbeing of pharmacies and health systems and support a stable
    work environment for their employees.

## Automate administrative tasks and enable new care models

Our vendor-neutral approach allows healthcare organizations to utilize their current infrastructure
and progressively expand, ensuring a tailored approach for every stage of the transformation
journey.

## Our solutions

Our portfolio of informatics solutions—medical device integration, system integration engine, cloud
data storage and analytics, clinical surveillance, intensive care and perioperative patient data
management, and virtual care—provides not just individual products, but a suite of applications that
seamlessly integrate with each other and your existing hospital systems.

[card-medical-device-integration]

## Medical Device Integration

Unlock the value of your medical devices with a vendor neutral platform that enables secure capture
of virtually all live-streaming data – measurements, settings, alarms and waveforms – from over
1,200 different medical devices. Data can be delivered using industry standard protocols to over 100
different systems, including electronic health records (EHRs), clinical information systems,
decision support, alarm management, research and reporting.

As health systems turn to virtual care models to address staffing shortages, eCareManager helps by
enabling inpatient care teams to seamlessly connect with remote clinicians. Timely insights,
customizable alerts and data-driven benchmarks with a goal of helping ensure the quality and
efficiency of patient care delivery.

Clinical Insights Manager is a service-oriented, end-to-end solution that allows hospitals to
synthesize high-fidelity clinical data. It combines storage and aggregation of data with tools that
allow you to query, filter and sort it so you can transform this information into valuable insights
that help you achieve your clinical healthcare goals.

# Exceptional People,
# Exceptional Outcomes

## A Medical Device Company Driven by a Shared Mission

As a global medical equipment manufacturer, we embrace a people-first culture that starts with a
mission to support our healthcare partners and the patients they serve. We design, build, and
distribute clinical products and surgical technologies for Orthopedic and General surgical
specialties, as well as patient monitoring needs, to medical institutions around the world —
enabling optimal patient outcomes.

### A Boldly Innovative Insufflation Solution

AirSeal^{®} is the only insufflator backed by clinical data* - positively affecting your patients'
intra and postoperative outcomes.

[ Learn More About AirSeal^{®} ][167]
[ Review the Data ][168]

### BioBrace^{®} Reinforced Bioinductive Implant

### The future of healing

The BioBrace^{®} implant combines the biological healing potential of highly porous Type I collagen
with the mechanical strength of PLLA microfilaments to support tendon healing. Engineered to protect
repairs during the vulnerable healing phase, the BioBrace^{®} implant promotes tissue growth,
reduces stress on healing tissue, and supports the body's natural healing processes.

[ Learn More About BioBrace^{®} ][169]
[ See the Data ][170]

### Y-Knotless™ Flex All-Suture Knotless Anchor: Shuttle with Ease. Fixate with Confidence.

The next generation of knotless technology is here with Y-Knotless™ Flex. Engineered for effortless
shuttling and designed to provide color-coded clarity during each step of the procedure.

headquartered in Warwick, RI. CTI develops, markets and distributes a wide range of patient
monitoring devices and anesthetic gas monitoring systems which incorporate technological innovation
with cost-effective features. CTI products address patient safety concerns and monitoring needs in
anesthesia, critical care, respiratory care, transport and outpatient care environments.
Comprehensive customer and technical support programs make even its most advanced systems

## Corsano CardioWatch

Cardiowatch is a wireless remote monitoring system intended for continuous collection of
physiological data in healthcare and home settings. Cardiowatch is a CE medical device certified
under EU-MDR standards and FDA 510(k) Cleared. This includes Pulse Rate, Heart Rate Variability (R-R
intervals), ECG, SpO2, Respiration, Blood Pressure, Core Body Temperature, Activity and Sleep. Data
is transmitted wirelessly from the bracelet via the application or gateway to a health cloud where
it is stored and made available for further analysis.

Corsano Cardiowatch can include the ability to notify healthcare professionals when physiological
data fall outside selected parameters.

## Clinical Trials

Corsano is enabling clinical trials, in-hospital and remote patient care across the entire care
continuum with our clinically validated and EU-MDR and FDA certified CardioWatch 287 System.

Corsano is currently involved in over 100 clinical trials – **Cardiovascular, Oncology and Stress**.
Corsano’s medically certified wearables increase credibility of studies and prepare for medical
digital therapies. Corsano’s involvement in important clinical trial research consortia accelerates
the pace of medical research, enabling the discovery of new biomarkers and their clinical
validation. 

## Real-time Remote Patient Monitoring

Corsano CardioWatch 287 can monitor up to 19 Vital Parameters in real-time while post-discharge
programs often rely solely on episodic vitals (spot measurements). Healthcare providers can
develop **personalized treatment plans** that address the unique needs of each patient. Corsano can
provide patients with real-time feedback on their progress, which can help motivate them to adhere
to their treatment plan. Remote care-at-home programs deliver improved clinical outcomes, lower
costs and better patient experience: **38% ****reduction in cost of care****; ****70% ****reduction
in readmissions**; **50%**** improvement in patient mobility**

## Clinical Trials

Corsano is enabling clinical trials, in-hospital and remote patient care across the entire care
continuum with our clinically validated and EU-MDR and FDA certified CardioWatch 287 System.

Corsano is currently involved in over 100 clinical trials – **Cardiovascular, Oncology and Stress**.
Corsano’s medically certified wearables increase credibility of studies and prepare for medical
digital therapies. Corsano’s involvement in important clinical trial research consortia accelerates
the pace of medical research, enabling the discovery of new biomarkers and their clinical
validation. 

## Real-time Remote Patient Monitoring

Corsano CardioWatch 287 can monitor up to 19 Vital Parameters in real-time while post-discharge
programs often rely solely on episodic vitals (spot measurements). Healthcare providers can
develop **personalized treatment plans** that address the unique needs of each patient. Corsano can
provide patients with real-time feedback on their progress, which can help motivate them to adhere
to their treatment plan. Remote care-at-home programs deliver improved clinical outcomes, lower
costs and better patient experience: **38% ****reduction in cost of care****; ****70% ****reduction
in readmissions**; **50%**** improvement in patient mobility**

## Redefining clinical research through medical wearables and digital biomarkers


Our FDA-cleared health monitoring tools are designed to seamlessly collect and monitor health data
from daily life. Empatica provides the world’s largest selection of digital measures from a single,
versatile wearable, taking gold-standard health measurements from the clinic to the comfort of
people’s homes.

More than half of the top 20 pharmaceutical companies use the Empatica Health Monitoring Platform to

# Innovating Drug Delivery, Together

## ExtruPharm works with pharma and biotech innovators to design and manufacture advanced
## polymer-based drug delivery systems — from early concepts to clinical-ready prototypes and
## beyond.

[ Work With Us ][9]

## ExtruPharm Provides a Variety of Design and manufacturing Services

Our team brings together expertise in extrusion, injection molding, and custom polymer processing to
design, develop, and refine advanced drug delivery devices. Every project is approached with
precision and innovation to ensure that each device meets the most rigorous performance, quality
standards, and the demanding specifications of each client.

[[Research and development images of various drug delivery devices]][10]

## Products & Applications

### Shaping the Future of Combination Devices

Our expertise extends across a wide range of device formats and materials. Whether your program
requires durability, bioresorbability, or unique geometries, ExtruPharm is positioned to deliver.

### Applications Include:
* Drug-eluting implants for sustained and long-acting release
* Parenteral and implantable devices for direct-to-target or systemic delivery
* Custom geometries including rods, tubes, films, co-extruded structures, and complex profiles
* Next-generation combination devices built with polymer science and process innovation at the core

### Materials We Work With:
* Bio-durable polymers such as EVA and TPU
* Bioresorbable polymers including PLA, PLGA, PCL, and more
* Customized material blends and advanced formulations

## Why Choose ExtruPharm

ExtruPharm is built around flexibility, technical depth, and cost-effectiveness. We are an ideal
partner for pharmaceutical and biotech companies seeking innovative solutions without unnecessary
overhead.

### Cost-Effective Development

Our rates are typically a fraction of larger CDMOs, allowing you to conserve budget for clinical
manufacturing.

### IP Protection

You retain full ownership of your intellectual property. All work performed is yours to transfer,
scale, or commercialize without restrictions

### Scalable & Transferable

Every process we design is built to be transferable — whether to a GMP CDMO of your choosing or to
one of ExtruPharm’s strategic partners.

### Agile & Responsive

As a small, specialized company, we move quickly, provide direct access to experts, and adapt to
your program’s unique needs.

### Custom Solutions

From modifying processes to designing equipment, we go beyond off-the-shelf solutions to ensure your
project’s success

### Industry Connections

Our strong relationships with leading equipment and material suppliers give you access to the right
resources, at the right time.

## About ExtruPharm

ExtruPharm is a Contract Development and Manufacturing Organization (CDMO) specializing in the
development of polymer-based drug delivery devices

Since 2018, we have been helping companies bring complex ideas to life through expertise in
extrusion technologies, injection molding, and custom device engineering. Our focus is on creating
drug-eluting implants, parenteral devices, and combination products that improve patient outcomes
through controlled drug release.

In 2025, ExtruPharm expanded into a new 5,500 sq. ft. R&D facility in Auburn, Massachusetts,
enabling us to deliver analytical support and scalable prototype manufacturing with seamless
pathways toward GMP production through tech transfer partnerships.

We work with clients of all sizes — from startups to established pharmaceutical companies and
Universities — to deliver innovative solutions that are flexible, cost-effective, and tailored to
your program’s needs.

Applying for a grant? ExtruPharm is ideally situated to help with flat-fee services to keep you in
budget and meeting your grant timelines and deliverables.

### Our Vision

We see a world of untethered healthcare driven by wireless Biosensors and patient monitoring
systems, coupled with AI-driven smart analytics.

We have worked relentlessly for years to produce a family of medically-actionable wearable
Biosensors and systems, to enable our vision of granting healthcare monitoring access to everyone
around the globe, regardless of economic status or proximity to hospitals.

[ Learn About Our Vision ][36]

### UbiqVue^{TM} Wireless Patient Monitoring

UbiqVue Patient Monitoring System assists partners in rapidly deploying wireless solutions to
healthcare settings with minimal investment. We provide end-to-end and integration systems that
enable the transformation of in-hospital, hospital-at-home and ambulatory healthcare delivery. This
enables enhanced patient care and data-driven clinical insights by untethering patients from wired
constraints while capturing continuous vital signs across care settings.

Wireless Hospitals and Virtual Wards

Near real-time vital sign monitoring system ready for immediate implementation into large-scale
in-hospital and hospital-at-home delivery solutions.

[ UbiqVue Multiparameter ][38]

Ambulatory cardiac services

Cloud-based Holter ECG monitoring, analysis, and reporting solution ready for immediate
implementation into large-scale Holter delivery solutions.

Our range of clinical-grade, [disposable Biosensors support evolving][40] healthcare delivery
requirements while optimizing patient comfort and compliance. By leveraging our patented LSP silicon
platform, we will continue to expand our offerings as the boundaries of wireless healthcare broaden.

## Welcome to MedWorks Advantage, your trusted partner in the healthcare industry. We are on a
## mission to promote the well-being of our community by offering top-quality medical equipment,
## essential supplies, and valuable resources. Our unwavering commitment to excellence, competitive

## Institutional Medical equipment supplies

### Why Choose
### MedWorks Advantage

At MedWorks Advantage, we take pride in being your one-stop solution for all your medical supply
needs. Whether you’re operating a hospital, surgery center, or in need of bulk medical supplies, we
have you covered. We understand the critical importance of having access to reliable, high-quality
medical resources in the healthcare industry, and we’re here to ensure you have everything you need
to deliver outstanding patient care.

### Extensive Experience

With over 25 years of experience in the healthcare sector, we deeply understand the unique
challenges and requirements you face. Our expertise enables us to provide you with precisely what
you need.

### Quality Assurance

We collaborate with ISO and FDA-approved suppliers, ensuring that you receive only the best in
quality and safety. Your patients' well-being is our priority.

### Prompt Shipping

Timeliness is crucial in healthcare. With our state-of-the-art online tracking system, you're always
in the know about the status of your orders. You can expect efficient and reliable delivery every
time.

## Our Comprehensive
## Range of Wholesale Medical Supplies

### Medical Equipment

We offer a wide array of cutting-edge medical equipment from diagnostic tools to treatment
apparatus. Our selection includes the latest in patient monitoring systems, surgical instruments,
and advanced imaging devices. Whether you want to upgrade your facility or stock up on essentials,
we've got you covered.

### Medical Devices

From infusion pumps to respiratory devices, we supply a diverse range of medical devices to support
various patient needs. Our devices are sourced from reputable manufacturers, ensuring the highest
quality and reliability.

### General Medical Supplies

Our commitment to being your comprehensive medical supply source extends to general supplies,
including but not limited to bandages, syringes, gauze, and more. We understand that these essential
items are the backbone of healthcare, and you can rely on us to have a well-stocked inventory.

Infection control and patient safety are paramount in healthcare. That's why we offer a range of
disposable medical supplies, such as gloves, masks, and sterilization products. Our disposable
supplies adhere to strict quality standards, offering you peace of mind in every use.

## About Us

Advanced medical equipment plays a crucial role in enhancing the quality of life and fulfilling
people's unwavering pursuit of good health. With the belief that "the world is flat" and "a healthy
world is accessible," the founders of Minttihealth have joined hands with the aim of leveraging
modern technologies to create a better and healthier world.

Minttihealth takes pride in its exceptional team, which mainly consists of scientists from the
Chinese Academy of Sciences, who are leaders in their respective fields such as sensors, acoustic
signal processing, electro-physiological signal processing, intelligent network platform
construction, and algorithms. Some of our team members come from the design and manufacturing
industries of intelligent electronic products, with the ability to transform blueprints into
reality. Others are from top medical equipment companies worldwide, who possess a profound insight
into the global medical market.

Minttihealth has a valuable resource of expert clinical medical professionals, who act as the
primary data entry for our telemedicine system. With their extensive clinical experience combined
with vast amounts of user data, we can efficiently test and upgrade algorithm calibration and
inspection.

At Minttihealth, we continuously strive to discover novel ways and means for healthcare and disease
prevention. Starting with the hardware/software technology of the medical Internet of Things, we are
committed to optimizing disease management and auxiliary diagnosis and treatment practices. Our
primary focus is on the application of medical and health big data analysis and intelligence (AI),
ensuring that everyone has access to advanced and efficient medical care health network.

## About Us

Advanced medical equipment plays a crucial role in enhancing the quality of life and fulfilling
people's unwavering pursuit of good health. With the belief that "the world is flat" and "a healthy
world is accessible," the founders of Minttihealth have joined hands with the aim of leveraging
modern technologies to create a better and healthier world.

Minttihealth takes pride in its exceptional team, which mainly consists of scientists from the
Chinese Academy of Sciences, who are leaders in their respective fields such as sensors, acoustic
signal processing, electro-physiological signal processing, intelligent network platform
construction, and algorithms. Some of our team members come from the design and manufacturing
industries of intelligent electronic products, with the ability to transform blueprints into
reality. Others are from top medical equipment companies worldwide, who possess a profound insight
into the global medical market.

Minttihealth has a valuable resource of expert clinical medical professionals, who act as the
primary data entry for our telemedicine system. With their extensive clinical experience combined
with vast amounts of user data, we can efficiently test and upgrade algorithm calibration and
inspection.

At Minttihealth, we continuously strive to discover novel ways and means for healthcare and disease
prevention. Starting with the hardware/software technology of the medical Internet of Things, we are
committed to optimizing disease management and auxiliary diagnosis and treatment practices. Our
primary focus is on the application of medical and health big data analysis and intelligence (AI),
ensuring that everyone has access to advanced and efficient medical care health network.

# Clinical systems engineered for measured decisions from ICU to home care.

Mindray aligns bedside monitors, anesthesia workstations, portable ultrasound workflows, and
discharge-ready DME programs with traceable performance data, service accountability, and
interoperability documentation.

[Review Performance Data][8] [Speak to a Clinical Specialist][9]
Deployment readiness

## Technical documentation grouped for value analysis committees.

Each program package is organized around clinical accuracy, lifecycle support, cybersecurity, and
reimbursement context so biomed, nursing, IT, and procurement teams can work from the same evidence
set.

### Patient monitoring performance

SpO2 accuracy tables, ECG waveform export, alarm priority mapping under IEC 60601-1-8, HL7
observation push frequency, and post-market surveillance summaries are supplied for committee
review.

### Respiratory and anesthesia continuity

Ventilator-monitor connectivity, anesthesia workstation service intervals, vaporizers and gas module
verification, transport battery expectations, and alarm fatigue mitigation are documented before
evaluation.

### Hospital-to-home handoff

Home health bundles include caregiver training, FHIR-ready observations, Bluetooth pairing guides,
cellular fallback options, and HCPCS context for DME coordination.
[ICU monitoring station]
Closed-loop monitoring

## Waveforms, alarms, and observations are built for clinical governance.

Mindray monitoring workflows document priority alarms, waveform fidelity, NIBP protocols, SpO2
tolerances, and event export controls. The result is a cleaner handoff between bedside teams, biomed
service, informatics, and post-market quality reporting.

[Anesthesia workstation in operating room]
Respiratory continuity

## OR, ICU, and transport teams share the same service vocabulary.

Respiratory and anesthesia programs include preventive maintenance plans, gas module verification,
battery runtime documentation, spare-part depot coverage, and escalation routing so uptime claims
can be reviewed against operational controls.

[Home monitoring kit]
Discharge-ready care

## Home care programs keep clinical evidence attached to the device.

Caregiver guides, training checklists, device pairing steps, and remote observation workflows make
discharge planning easier for case managers while preserving traceability for clinical operations
and supply teams.

**ISO 13485**QMS aligned documentation
**FHIR R4**Integration planning support
**24/7**Service escalation routing
**510(k)**Regulatory file support
**UDI**Device identity controls

### Hospitals

coverage.

### Surgical Centers

Anesthesia workstations, perioperative monitoring, alarm review, and device training for rotating
teams.

RPM

### Remote Care

Home observation kits, FHIR-ready data pathways, caregiver training, and adherence reporting.

DME

### Home Health

Discharge bundles, DME documentation, patient support routing, and supply continuity planning.

Procurement confidence

## What clinical and biomedical teams ask us to prove.

"Mindray's technical file format made our alarm governance review more concrete. We could compare
priorities, export behavior, and service coverage before device trials."

**Director of Clinical Engineering**Academic hospital network

"The respiratory care packet joined OR, ICU, and transport workflows in one review. That reduced
duplicate questions from anesthesia, nursing, and biomed."

**Perioperative Technology Lead**Regional surgical program

"For home monitoring, the caregiver training and data path documentation gave our discharge team a
practical starting point for remote follow-up."

**Population Health Manager**Home care program

Precision-based patient monitoring solutions

# Smarter anesthesia.
# Safer recoveries.

Trusted by thousands of clinicians, TetraGraph delivers smart and accurate train-of-four (TOF)
monitoring to optimize intubation conditions, neuromuscular block management and reversal dosing. 

[Discover TetraGraph][11]  [Request TetraGraph demo][12]

Designed with focus on sustainability, performance and usability

## New TetraSens sensor out!

Supporting clinicians with improved visual guidance for faster, more consistent placement.

Compared with legacy sensors, the new sensor design uses 50% less dielectric material while
maintaining the same trusted performance specifications. It is manufactured in Europe using a more
environmentally friendly process, supported by a regional supply chain and shorter transportation
routes.

Data-driven clinical insights for next-generation neuromuscular monitoring

## Introducing TetraAnalytics data analytics platform

TetraAnalytics is a cloud-based data analytics platform for next-generation TetraGraph users. 

The platform transforms invisible patterns into operational insights, helping healthcare teams apply
clinical best practices, optimize workflows, and achieve better patient and economic outcomes.

[ Explore TetraAnalytics][13]

### (IPMRS)

 Strengthen pandemic prevention, preparedness, and response capacities

Our innovative Vitals Hub enables an Integrated Patient Monitoring & Report System (IPMRS) resulting
in a patient centric network thus bringing together Patients, Patients Care Personnel and their
Electronic Health Records(EHR) from health organizations. 

* Applicable to multiple health specialties
* Ability to use commercial off the shelf equipment, standard interfaces and health standards
* Automated vitals data entry for use by health care and emergency contact personnel
* Vitals tolerances and trigger points tailorable to individual patient for reporting
* Integrated vitals, food and meds data to get the whole picture
* Patient specific reports at required intervals to healthcare providers
* Patient specific Critical Alerts even when device is locked, when vitals are out of specified
  range
* Six Sigma based continuous Quality Improvements

why TimeDoc Health has been a lifeline that allows us to manage a growing population of patients
across the state. In Colorado, the majority of our constituents are living in rural communities –
from Baca to Garfield County – and in mountainous regions that have limited access to care centers.
If we can increase the frequency of when and how we connect with patients, we will be able to make
more accurate decisions around their long-term care needs.

**Janelle Lucero, RMA**
Chronic Care Management Coordinator
Valley-Wide Health Systems

integrating R&D, production, sales and service. Now Yonker has seven subsidiaries.The products in3
categories cover more than 20 series include oximeters, patient monitors, ECG, syringe pumps, blood
pressure monitors, oxygen concentrator, nebulizers etc., which are exported to more than 140
countries and regions.

Yonker has two R&D centers in Shenzhen and Xuzhou with a R&D team of about 100 person. At present we
have nearly 200 patents and authorized trademarks. Yonker also has three production bases cover an
area of 40000 square meters equipped with independent laboratories, testing centers, professional
intelligent SMT production lines, dust-free workshops, precision mold processing and injection
molding factories, forming a complete and cost-controllable production and quality control system.
The output is nearly 12 million units to meet the customized needs of global customers.

#### Introducing Zoe Medical

Zoe Medical, Inc. was founded in 1996, and has grown to become a recognized technology leader and
one of the largest manufacturers of patient monitoring systems in the United States.

Our substantial investment in R&D has fueled the introduction of many new products that benefit
customers in their everyday clinical work. Today, Zoe’s unique product architecture is running in
tens of thousands of installed units around the world. Our main office is located 30 miles north of
Boston in Topsfield, Massachusetts.

Most of our business has been designing and building products for other companies, including a
number of the world’s most highly regarded healthcare organizations. Zoe is now distributing
monitors and monitoring systems with our own label at factory direct prices. We invite you to learn

#### Introducing Zoe Medical

Zoe Medical, Inc. was founded in 1996, and has grown to become a recognized technology leader and
one of the largest manufacturers of patient monitoring systems in the United States.

Our substantial investment in R&D has fueled the introduction of many new products that benefit
customers in their everyday clinical work. Today, Zoe’s unique product architecture is running in
tens of thousands of installed units around the world. Our main office is located 30 miles north of
Boston in Topsfield, Massachusetts.

Most of our business has been designing and building products for other companies, including a
number of the world’s most highly regarded healthcare organizations. Zoe is now distributing
monitors and monitoring systems with our own label at factory direct prices. We invite you to learn
more about our products, and would love to talk with you about any of your patient monitoring needs!

Designed, manufactured, and supported in the USA
